title: boundaryMassOn is subadditive on differences and vanishes on boundaries
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and U, G ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets. Then (a) boundaryMassOn (X − Y) G ≤ boundaryMassOn X G + boundaryMassOn Y G for all X, Y ∈ 𝒟_m(U); and (b) boundaryMassOn (∂X) G = 0 for every X ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U). Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). Integrals ∫_E g dμ are Bochner integrals over μ⌞E; {d < t} abbreviates {x : d(x) < t}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U m, boundaryMassOn (X - Y) G ≤ boundaryMassOn X G + boundaryMassOn Y G) ∧ ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), boundaryMassOn X.boundary G = 0
